xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Imposition of fine amounting to INR 1,48,680- (Including GST) by National Stock Exchange of India Limited for the quarter ended 31 December 2024, for non compliance with the provisions of Regulation 19(1)/ 19(2) w.r.t. the constitution of Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The allegation pertains to the composition of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee allegedly not being in compliance with the provisions of SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015 during the quarter ended 31 December 2024. However, this is not a case of non-compliance but rather a temporary non-composition of the NRC for a brief period, owing to the completion of the tenure of Independent Directors. At no point was the NRC non-constituted, nor was its functioning affected. The Company has duly constituted the NRC in compliance with Regulation 19(1)/19(2) of SEBI Listing Regulations. The Company has filed waiver application in this regard.
